candidates.claim: CORP_IN permits tcp/22 from 192.168.30.0/24 to 10.10.99.0/24 (MGMT) as its first entry, and CORP_IN is bound inbound on the corp interface, so corporate hosts can open SSH connections into the MGMT side.
candidates.remediation: Remove the permit at fw-01:60 or restrict it to approved services, and reconcile the change with the approved baseline.

candidates.claim: Traffic between the MGMT side (OT side) and CORP is permitted on tcp/22 by the effective CORP_IN entry at fw-01:60, which is not one of the approved cross-zone services.
candidates.remediation: Remove the permit at fw-01:60 so that CORP to MGMT traffic is limited to approved services.

candidates.claim: The CORP_IN entry at fw-01:60 (permit tcp/22 from CORP to MGMT) is an addition relative to the approved baseline and must be reconciled.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile fw-01:60 against the approved baseline: revert the entry or record it as an approved change.
